sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that, in MFA No.101403/2016, which is an appeal filed by a neighboring land-loser, the learned single Judge enhanced the compensation from Rs.2,85,715/- per acre to Rs.5,00,000/- with all statutory benefits, interest and costs.
2. Learned counsel for the respondent-Nigam do not dispute the fact that the decision in the case of Sri. Sangappa Pandappa Lingaraddi Vs. The Special Land Acquisition Officer, in MFA No.101403/2016 pertains to the same acquisition notification and in respect of Hipparagi project.
However, it is submitted that, the appellants are not entitled for any interest during the delayed period, since this appeal was filed after a lapse of more than 1345 days.

sentences.text: 3. Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsels and on perusal of the orders passed in MFA No.101403/2016, this Court proceeds to allow the appeal partly.
4. The compensation awarded by the Reference Court stands enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/- per acre along with all statutory benefits, interests and costs.

However, the appellants shall not be entitle for payment of interest during the delayed period of 1345 days, as was ordered while considering the interlocutory application in I.A.No.2/2017, by an order of even date.

opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsels and on perusal of the orders passed in MFA No.101403/2016, this Court proceeds to allow the appeal partly.
4. The compensation awarded by the Reference Court stands enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/- per acre along with all statutory benefits, interests and costs.
However, the appellants shall not be entitle for payment of interest during the delayed period of 1345 days, as was ordered while considering the interlocutory application in I.A.No.2/2017, by an order of even date.
5. Ordered accordingly.
